reasoning_content:
Now the flow is clear. Onboarding has 3 steps:
1. `tour` — watch how it works
2. `join` — join workforce (needs profile: skills, education, location, etc.)
3. `payment` — add payout method

Until these are done → `NO_WORKFORCE_ACCESS` → no projects.

So the user must complete onboarding in the UI (tour, profile/join, payout). Payment likely PayPal or bank — user's own info.

Let me try to find the join endpoint (POST /api/v1/join/setup?) and what payment providers exist. Grep bundle for payout/paypal.

Then report to user: account created & verified; need to complete 3 steps in UI at app.claru.ai; then projects appear.

Let me check join/setup and payment methods quickly.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && echo "=== join/payout di bundle ==="; grep -oiE '"/[a-z0-9/_-]*(join|payout|payment|wallet|paypal|wise)[a-z0-9/_-]*"' /tmp/cl.js | sort -u | head -20; echo; echo "=== provider pembayaran ==="; grep -oiE 'paypal|wise|stripe|payoneer|bank transfer|usdc|crypto' /tmp/cl.js | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -8
